lead: I'm an engineering leader and technology strategist, currently VP Engineering at realfast.
paragraphs: In the dynamic landscape of technology, where chaos meets creativity, I've dedicated my career to transforming intricate challenges into streamlined solutions. My journey has taken me from engineering boots-on-the-ground at McKinsey & Company to leading innovative teams at Gojek and now steering engineering at realfast.ai.

At the heart of my work is the belief that technology is not just about solving problems: it's about unlocking potential. Whether improving operational efficiencies, enhancing team dynamics, or pioneering new AI capabilities, my drive comes from seeing tangible impacts: teams that thrive on collaboration, products that lead markets, and businesses that achieve unprecedented scalability.

I enjoy engineering as a solution to operational scale, when a system finally does the boring thing reliably: a deploy that takes five minutes instead of two weeks, or a harness that turns an agent from a slot machine into something you'd let near production.
